name: @oxcruise/app
description: Node host for oxcruise: CLI shim, plugin runtime, config loader and the programmatic API

scripts.build:binding: napi build --platform --esm --js-package-name @oxcruise/binding --release --features allocator,napi --output-dir src-js --js bindings.js --dts bindings.d.ts --no-dts-header
scripts.build:binding:debug: napi build --platform --esm --js-package-name @oxcruise/binding --features napi --output-dir src-js --js bindings.js --dts bindings.d.ts --no-dts-header
